items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Claudell, and a girl named Gonzell Motts, they were the models, more or less.

ctx.x: Did people really dress up to go to those places?

Yes, they did then. Yes. They dressed up to come then, because there was a girl named Claudell, boy that girl wore some clothes. Her mother used to make them. I think her mother was a dressmaker. Claudell, and a girl named Gonzell Motts, they were the models, more or less. And everybody would watch and see what they had on. And I don't like to sound like I'm boasting, but you want me to tell you -- want me to tell you this? They used to say I wore such smart clothes, you know.
